title: Identification of key circadian rhythm genes in skin aging based on bioinformatics and machine learning.
authors: Xiao, Xiao; Feng, Hao; Liao, Yangying; Tang, Hua; Li, Lan; Li, Ke; Hu, Feng
one_liner_zh: 基于生物信息学和机器学习筛选皮肤衰老相关昼夜节律基因，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，仅基因表达与免疫关联分析。
abstract: Skin aging is often accompanied by disruption of circadian rhythm and abnormal expression of circadian rhythm-related genes. In this study, we downloaded skin aging expression datasets from the GEO database and utilized bioinformatics and machine learning methods to explore circadian rhythm genes and pathways involved in skin aging, revealing the pathological and molecular mechanisms of skin aging. Results showed that 39 circadian rhythm-related genes (CRGs) were identified in skin aging, and these CRGs were enriched in signaling pathways such as glucagon signaling pathway, insulin resistance, thyroid hormone signaling pathway, and adipocytokine signaling pathway. Three key skin aging-related CRGs, SIRT1, ARNTL, and ATF4, were identified based on machine learning. Additionally, we found that skin aging was associated with infiltration of immune cells including NK cells activated, Macrophages M1, Mast cells resting, T cells CD4 memory activated, and Macrophages M2, and the expression of the three key skin aging-related CRGs was correlated with these immune cells. Finally, SIRT1, ARNTL, and ATF4 were all down-regulated in skin aging and had a good ability to distinguish young skin tissue from aging skin tissue. In conclusion, three key CRGs, including SIRT1, ARNTL, and ATF4, which are closely related to skin aging, were obtained based on bioinformatics and machine learning technology screening. These three key CRGs were potential risk genes for skin aging and also associated with changes in the immune microenvironment in skin aging. The language used in this paragraph follows the guidelines for scientific writing specified by SCI, making it clear and concise.
abstract_zh: 皮肤衰老常伴随昼夜节律紊乱及昼夜节律相关基因的异常表达。本研究从GEO数据库下载皮肤衰老表达数据集，并利用生物信息学和机器学习方法探索参与皮肤衰老的昼夜节律基因及通路，揭示皮肤衰老的病理和分子机制。结果显示，在皮肤衰老中鉴定出39个昼夜节律相关基因（CRGs），这些CRGs富集于胰高血糖素信号通路、胰岛素抵抗、甲状腺激素信号通路和脂肪细胞因子信号通路等信号通路中。基于机器学习，鉴定出三个关键的皮肤衰老相关CRGs，即SIRT1、ARNTL和ATF4。此外，我们发现皮肤衰老与免疫细胞浸润相关，包括活化的NK细胞、M1型巨噬细胞、静息肥大细胞、CD4记忆活化T细胞和M2型巨噬细胞，且这三个关键皮肤衰老相关CRGs的表达与这些免疫细胞相关。最后，SIRT1、ARNTL和ATF4在皮肤衰老中均下调，并具有良好的区分年轻皮肤组织与衰老皮肤组织的能力。总之，基于生物信息学和机器学习技术筛选，获得了与皮肤衰老密切相关的三个关键CRGs，包括SIRT1、ARNTL和ATF4。这三个关键CRGs是皮肤衰老的潜在风险基因，也与皮肤衰老中免疫微环境的变化相关。本段语言遵循SCI科学写作规范，清晰简洁。
